note: GD.42 include-style mounts, NestJS. main.ts calls `app.setGlobalPrefix('svc', { exclude: ['health'] })` (immich's shape, server/src/app.common.ts); app.module.ts registers `RouterModule.register([{ path: 'backoffice', module: AdminModule }])`, and admin.module.ts's `@Module({ controllers: [UsersController] })` puts UsersController under it. Every controller route takes the global prefix, AdminModule's its RouterModule path below it, and the excluded `health` keeps its own path. The client calls `/svc/..`, so only the prefixes pair it. Baseline (pre-change CLI, glia 0.5.5+p1f568a19): ROUTEs `GET /users/all`, `POST /users`, `GET /health`, `GET /version`, `[http] paired=1` (`/health` only).
